notes: A Learnings tab: browse and search everything the team has taught the app about the PeoplesHR code, filter by module, add one by hand.
Correct a learning (the old wording stays on the shelf with who changed it) or retire one that is wrong, with a reason; retired learnings stop reaching runs.
One shelf for both apps: the Bug Fixer and the PHR Feature Developer now share PeoplesHR-Learnings, and your existing learnings move across on their own.
If someone changed a learning while you were reading it, you are shown their version instead of overwriting it.
